title: Feed Velocity
tagline: Jump the algorithm before it buries you.
description: A climbing arcade game about social media. Ten platforms, and each level plays the way that platform's algorithm actually behaves.
longDescription: Feed Velocity turns algorithm anxiety into a jump game. TikTok platforms vanish because trends expire, Instagram posts ghost because reach is unreliable, and YouTube sends a rising demonetization wave. Strategy cards between levels share how I actually think about each platform.
role: Concept, game design, UI and development
challenge: Turn how each social platform really behaves into game mechanics, without a lecture to explain them.
solution: Gave each of the 10 platforms its own rules based on how it really works, plus strategy cards and an RSS-powered reader between levels for players who want the why.
next: Up next: leaderboards, new obstacle patterns and more reasons to take one more run.
